tests.summary: Pinned Node 22: 6 focused suites / 60 tests passed; 2 independent temporary adversarial suites / 4 tests passed after rework.
tests.focused: subtitles, IPC contracts, role restrictions, preload/bridge, embedded acknowledgement/session controls, renderer search/download/configuration

resolved: Closed subtitle dialogs dropped successful download results; guarded parent state delivery and refresh now pass the native-player reproduction.
Upstream metadata could produce unreadable saved manifests; bounded, control-cleaned metadata, saved-record validation and consistent manifest limits now pass oversized and 50-version reproductions.
New subtitle error/acknowledgement handling now rejects obsolete tokens and preserves video playback on current subtitle failure.

security_review: Renderer exposes IDs and bounded typed inputs; account writes are main-only; credentials use Electron safeStorage with no plaintext fallback/readback; subtitle IPC sanitizes errors without logging credentials; official API requests have finite response/timeout limits; download redirects revalidate provider HTTPS hosts and never forward API credentials; persistent generated assets are confined by realpath and UUID metadata; source video files are not modified.
risks: Authenticated search/download, quotas and real CDN behavior remain NOT RUN until a user configures their own service account.
Chromium renders basic ASS text cues; embedded MPV preserves ASS styling. External playback requires export/manual loading.
Archives, bitmap subtitles and font attachments are intentionally excluded.
Final desktop rebuild after delivery-document commit and real shortcut verification remain in progress under Local PM/root; independent QA did not run desktop checks.
Handoff commit identifies the reviewed implementation commit; compare Developer/QA handoffs against this SHA before release.
